name: Radolf Schneizen
original_name: ラードルフ・シュナイゼン
source:
A resident of the Lower World, and a Cardinal of the Elemia Church. His skills are among the best in the Church, especially with his sword.

Sympathizing with the Church's beliefs that "people should live in peace and harmony", he joined the Church when he was 16. He had a natural talent with the sword, and in five years, climbed to the highest rank of commander (Cardinal) within the knights of the Church.

A serious guy who takes pride in the happiness and protection that the Church's missions bring to the people. He can be stubborn at times, and he won't go back on his word. Unlike most other leaders in the Church, he doesn't believe that the Goddesses' descent is a priority.

Voiced by: Masakazu Handa (Japanese), Vic Mignogna (English)
